caption:
Hybi's Weekly Recap for Nov 9–14 is here.

Heading back to the gym after an injury? Start weeks 1–2 at about half your usual load, and add weight, sets or sessions, not all three. At home, slow bridges and dead bugs, 8–10 each, are a simple start. A 10-minute walk the evening after a massage helps keep things moving. Working from the couch? Raise the laptop on a firm cushion and change spots every hour.

Scroll back through this week's posts for the full comics. Book online via the link in bio 🐱
